content:
nina: Heads-up: tenant ten_99 reports v2 badge in console but audit logs show requests executed on v1 after fallback. noticed on a few burst windows.
arjun: can you share a request id?
nina: 03HGF12AB9C000XYZ. logs: quota counter incremented for v2 before routing decided to fallback to v1_small. console reads quota counter for badge.
claire: sounds like ordering bug: quota middleware runs pre-routing and commits tentatively. if routing falls back we never decrement.
eng-sre-bot: [metric] per-tenant version_attribution_delta spiked to 0.18 for ten_99 (5m).
arjun: mitigation options: 1) delay commit until after final route, 2) emit attempted_version vs executed_version and make console prefer executed, 3) compensating decrement on fallback.
nina: prefer 2 for fast rollout + 1 long term.
claire: i'll add executed_version tag to logs and update dashboard badge to prefer that. small UI copy change: "badge shows executed model when available".
ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy of routing emit change at 1769870088.
eng-sre-bot: [deploy] routing-service canary live.
arjun: i'll prepare compensating-decrement PR as safety net (WIP).
nina: rolling plan: deploy console read change first, enable canary routing emit, follow with quota refactor. i'll notify billing and CS.
claire: created dashboard alert: tenant delta > 0.05 -> eng-platform oncall.
nina: thanks, team. will monitor for an hour then widen rollout. :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread serialized as one string; messages prefixed by sender. No title per agents.md.
